---
title: "Planet Imagery Updates 2025"
output: html_document
date: "2025-06-25"
---

# Load Packages

```{r}
library(sf)
library(tidyverse)
```

# Load Data

```{r}
arts = st_read("../ARTS/ARTS_main_dataset/v.3.1.0/ARTS_main_dataset_v.3.1.0.geojson")
```

# Delineations from 2024

```{r}
arts = arts |>
  separate(
    BaseMapDate, 
    into = c("BaseMapStartDate", "BaseMapEndDate"), 
    sep = ",",
    remove = FALSE
    ) |>
  mutate(
    across(
      .cols = c(BaseMapStartDate, BaseMapEndDate),
      ~ as_date(.x)
      )
    )
```

```{r}
arts2024 = arts |>
  filter(BaseMapStartDate > as_date('2024-01-01') | BaseMapEndDate > as_date('2024-01-01'))
```
